request.description: Make a clean IMPACT keyframe. Remove every spark, orange/red glow, flare and hot spot. Restore the entire plate as cold opaque steel-grey. Place the flat bottom striking face of the hammer firmly touching the plate upper surface at the impact point: no visible air gap. Keep tongs gripping its right edge. Preserve exact smith pose, feet, face, hands, clothes, plate outline, camera, scale, transparency and pixel style. No other changes.
